## Checklist

- [ ] PR title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/)
- [ ] `ruff format --check .` and `ruff check .` pass
- [ ] `mypy src` passes
- [ ] `pytest tests/` passes

- [ ] Updated docs (`README.md` / `MANUAL.md`) if behavior changed
- [ ] Commits are signed (`git commit -S`)
